chunks: Ali ibn Abdullah al-Warraq, and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Qazwini, known as Ibn Maqbara, told us; he said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah ibn Abi Khalaf al-Ash'ari told us, he said: Al- Abbas ibn Sa'id al-Azraq told us, he said: Abu Nasr told us, from Isa ibn Mahran, from al-Hasan ibn al-Wahhab, from Muhammad ibn Marwan, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Do you know the interpretation of 'Hasten to the best of deeds'? I said: No. He said: He has called you to al-barr (loyalty/piety). Do you know loyalty to whom? I said: No. He said: He has called you to loyalty to Fatima and her sons, peace be upon them.

key_terms.الْبَرِّ: Loyalty, piety, or goodness (specifically referring to devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt here)
key_terms.حَيَّ عَلَى خَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ: Hasten to the best of deeds (phrase from Adhan)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Hasten to the best of deeds' in the Shia interpretation of the Adhan?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the Adhan phrase 'Hasten to the best of deeds' by defining 'barr' (righteousness/loyalty) specifically as devotion to Fatima and her progeny. This interpretation elevates the recognition of the Ahl al-Bayt from a general act of piety to the paramount deed invoked in the daily call to prayer, underscoring their central role in Shia theological practice.

en.basel-kadem: 3.	We were told by Ali bin Abdullah al-Warraq, and Ali bin Muhammed bin Hasan al-Qazwini, known as Ibn Maqbara, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah bin Abi Khalaf al-Ash’ari, that he said: We were told by Abbas ibn Sa’eed al-Azraq, that he said: We were told by Abu Nasr, from Isa bin Mahran, from Hasan bin Abdul-Wahhab, from Muhammed bin Marwan, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him, that he said:

Do you know what is the interpretation of «Hasten to the best of deeds»? I said: No. He said: He has called you to loyalty. Do you know loyalty to whom? I said: No. He said: He has called you to loyalty to  Fatima and her sons, peace be upon them.
